root_text: A report from mid-January suggests that HMPV is already currently increasing in some parts of the United States, including in Kansas, Iowa, Missouri and Nebraska. So, it's something to keep an eye on but certainly nothing to panic about.

nodes.text:
A report from mid-January suggests that HMPV is already currently increasing in some parts of the United States, including in Kansas, Iowa, Missouri and Nebraska. So, it's something to keep an eye on but certainly nothing to panic about.
